description:
The largest of the sample blueprints - a complete energy-management demo for
one industrial site, from assets to dashboard:

  master-data/assets.yaml        PV system, inverter, storage, meters and
                                 consumers, plus carbon emissions/budget,
                                 certificates of origin, compliance records,
                                 environmental goals, KPIs, costs, forecasts
                                 and a demand-response event
  master-data/load-profile.yaml  quarter-hour load profile as
                                 Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement entities
  notifications/alerts.yaml      stateful events surfaced as dashboard alerts
  queries/*.yaml                 the three saved queries the widgets bind to
  ui/dashboard.yaml              the Meshboard dashboard and its 14 widgets

Data-only - no pipelines, no adapter, nothing to deploy. Install and open the
"energy-environment" dashboard.

Demo and training tenants only.
